newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CNPC places 33 mln shrs at HK$0.3114 each.
newsitem.headline: CNPC places 33 mln shrs at HK$0.3114 each.

text.p: China-funded oil explorer CNPC (Hong Kong) Ltd has agreed to place 33.11 million new shares, or 0.86 percent of the expanded share capital, to an independent investor, Integrated Asset Management (Asia) Ltd, at HK$0.3114 per share, CNPC said in a statement on Tuesday.
CNPC's chairman Li Changlin said proceeds froom the placing of about HK$10.31 million would be used to settle a disputed debt of HK$21.7 million with a creditor.
Integrated Asset is owned by a Canadian Chinese, Yam Tak Cheung, whose main business comprises securities investment and ownership of a garment business.
The placing is conditional on the stock exchange granting listing approval for the new shares on October 9.
CNPC shares ended at HK$0.365 each on Monday, up HK$0.005.
